names: Father of King Xiao of Liang

sourceDate.text: Warring States activity of Han Feizi

manner.en: fell ill, vomited blood, and died

units.zh: 御史大夫韓安國者，梁成安人也，後徙睢陽。
units.en: The Grand Censor Han Anguo was a native of Cheng'an in the kingdom of Liang, and later moved to Suiyang.
units.literal: Imperial censor Han Anguo, Liang Cheng'an person, later moved Suiyang.

units.zh: 嘗受韓子、雜家說於騶田生所。
units.en: He once studied the writings of Han Feizi and the teachings of the Eclectic School under Master Zou Tian.
units.literal: Once received Hanzi, miscellaneous learning from Zou Tiansheng place.

units.zh: 事梁孝王為中大夫。
units.en: He served King Xiao of Liang as a Palace Grandee.
units.literal: Served Liang Xiao wang as central grand master.

units.zh: 吳楚反時，孝王使安國及張羽為將，捍吳兵於東界。
units.en: When Wu and Chu rebelled, King Xiao dispatched Anguo and Zhang Yu as generals to defend the eastern border against the forces of Wu.
units.literal: Wu Chu rebellion time, Xiao wang sent Anguo and Zhang Yu as generals, defended Wu troops at eastern border.

units.zh: 張羽力戰，安國持重，以故吳不能過梁。
units.en: Zhang Yu fought with fierce determination while Anguo held a steady defensive position, and so the armies of Wu were unable to advance past Liang.
units.literal: Zhang Yu vigorously fought, Anguo held steady, therefore Wu could not pass Liang.

units.zh: 吳楚已破，安國、張羽名由此顯。
units.en: After Wu and Chu were defeated, the names of Anguo and Zhang Yu became renowned throughout the realm.
units.literal: Wu Chu already broken, Anguo, Zhang Yu fame from this prominent.

units.zh: 梁孝王，景帝母弟，竇太后愛之，令得自請置相、二千石，出入游戲，僭於天子。
units.en: King Xiao of Liang was Emperor Jing's younger brother by the same mother. Empress Dowager Dou doted on him, allowing him to appoint his own chancellor and officials of two-thousand-shi rank, to come and go at his pleasure, and to adopt ceremonies that exceeded those appropriate for anyone but the Son of Heaven.
units.literal: Liang Xiao wang, Emperor Jing younger brother, Empress Dowager Dou loved him, ordered got self request appoint chancellor, two thousand shi, enter leave play games, exceeded emperor.

units.zh: 天子聞之，心弗善也。
units.en: When the Emperor heard of this, he was displeased.
units.literal: Emperor heard it, heart not good.

units.zh: 太后知帝不善，乃怒梁使者，弗見，案責王所為。
units.en: When the Empress Dowager learned of the Emperor's displeasure, she turned her anger upon the envoys from Liang, refusing to grant them audience and instead investigating and censuring the king's conduct.
units.literal: Empress dowager knew emperor not good, then angered Liang envoys, not saw, examined blamed wang conduct.

units.zh: 韓安國為梁使，見大長公主而泣曰：「何梁王為人子之孝，為人臣之忠，太后曾弗省也？
units.en: Han Anguo, as envoy of Liang, went to see the Grand Princess and wept, saying, "How can it be that the King of Liang's filial piety as a son and loyalty as a minister have never won the Empress Dowager's regard?
units.literal: Han Anguo as Liang envoy, saw Grand Princess and wept, saying: "How can it be that the King of Liang's filial piety as a son and loyalty as a minister have never won the Empress Dowager's regard?

units.zh: 夫前日吳、楚、齊、趙七國反時，自關以東皆合從西鄉，惟梁最親為艱難。
units.en: In the past, when the Seven Kingdoms of Wu, Chu, Qi, and Zhao rebelled, all the lands east of the passes united and marched westward, yet it was Liang alone—the kingdom closest to the throne—that bore the hardest fighting.
units.literal: Because previous Wu, Chu, Qi, Zhao seven kingdoms rebellion time, from pass eastward all united following west direction, only Liang most intimate for difficulties.

units.zh: 梁王念太后、帝在中，而諸侯擾亂，一言泣數行下，跪送臣等六人，將兵擊卻吳楚，吳楚以故兵不敢西，而卒破亡，梁王之力也。
units.en: The King of Liang, mindful that the Empress Dowager and the Emperor stood at the center while the feudal lords threw the realm into chaos, wept with every word he spoke, tears streaming down his face. He knelt and sent off six of us as generals, who led troops to drive back Wu and Chu. Because of this, the armies of Wu and Chu dared not advance westward and were ultimately destroyed—all through the efforts of the King of Liang.
units.literal: Liang wang thought empress dowager, emperor in center, but feudal lords disturbance chaos, one word wept several rows down, knelt sent us six people, led troops repelled Wu Chu, Wu Chu therefore troops not dared west, and finally broken perished, Liang wang effort.

units.zh: 今太后以小睗苛禮責望梁王。
units.en: Now the Empress Dowager, on account of minor suspicions and rigid protocols, censures and finds fault with the King of Liang.
units.literal: Now empress dowager with small suspicion harsh etiquette blamed expected Liang wang.

units.zh: 梁王父兄皆帝王，所見者大，故出稱蹕，入言警，車旗皆帝所賜也，即欲以侘鄙縣，驅馳國中，以夸諸侯，令天下盡知太后、帝愛之也。
units.en: The King of Liang's father and brothers were all emperors, so naturally his vision is grand. When he goes abroad he calls for the roads to be cleared, and when he returns he commands the imperial alert—but his carriages and banners were all bestowed upon him by the Emperor himself. He merely wished to display them through the humble counties and ride throughout his kingdom, to impress the feudal lords and let all under heaven know that the Empress Dowager and the Emperor loved him.
units.literal: Liang wang father brothers all emperors, what saw great, therefore out used imperial way, enter spoke imperial alert, carriages banners all emperor granted, immediately wanted with lowly county, drive in country, to boast feudal lords, make realm all know empress dowager, emperor loved him.

units.zh: 今梁使來，輒案責之。
units.en: Yet now, whenever envoys arrive from Liang, they are immediately subjected to interrogation and blame.
units.literal: Now Liang envoys come, immediately examined blamed them.

units.zh: 梁王恐，日夜涕泣思慕，不知所為。
units.en: The King of Liang is terrified, weeping day and night with longing, not knowing what to do.
units.literal: Liang wang feared, day night wept thought longed, not knew what to do.

units.zh: 何梁王之為子孝，為臣忠，而太后弗恤也？」
units.en: How can the King of Liang be so filial as a son and so loyal as a minister, yet the Empress Dowager show him no compassion?"
units.literal: How Liang King's conduct as son filial, as minister loyal, yet Empress Dowager not show compassion?"

units.zh: 大長公主具以告太后，太后喜曰：「為言之帝。」
units.en: The Grand Princess told the Empress Dowager everything. The Empress Dowager was pleased and said, "Speak of this to the Emperor."
units.literal: Grand Princess fully reported to Empress Dowager; Empress Dowager pleased, said: "Speak of this to the Emperor."

units.zh: 言之，帝心乃解，而免冠謝太后曰：「兄弟不能相教，乃為太后遺憂。」
units.en: When she did so, the Emperor's mind was eased. He removed his cap and apologized to the Empress Dowager, saying, "We brothers could not instruct one another, and thus caused Your Majesty sorrow."
units.literal: When she spoke of it, Emperor's mind then eased; he removed cap and apologized to Empress Dowager, saying: "We brothers could not instruct one another, and thus caused Your Majesty sorrow."

units.zh: 悉見梁使，厚賜之。
units.en: He received all the envoys from Liang and bestowed generous gifts upon them.
units.literal: All saw Liang envoys, thickly granted them.

units.zh: 其後梁王益親驩。
units.en: After this, the King of Liang enjoyed even closer and warmer relations with the court.
units.literal: Its after Liang wang increasingly intimate close.

units.zh: 太后、長公主更賜安國可直千餘金。
units.en: The Empress Dowager and the Grand Princess in turn rewarded Anguo with gifts worth over a thousand pieces of gold.
units.literal: Empress dowager, grand princess moreover granted Anguo value thousand remainder gold.

units.zh: 名由此顯，結於漢。
units.en: His name became illustrious from this, and he forged ties with the Han court.
units.literal: Name from this prominent, attached to Han.

units.zh: 其後安國坐法抵罪，蒙獄吏田甲辱安國。
units.en: Later, Anguo was convicted of a crime and imprisoned. While in prison, the jailer Tian Jia humiliated him.
units.literal: Its after Anguo sat law violated crime, endured prison official Tian Jia insulted Anguo.

units.zh: 安國曰：「死灰獨不復然乎？」
units.en: Anguo said, "Can dead ashes alone not blaze up again?"
units.literal: Anguo said: "Can dead ashes alone not blaze up again?"

units.zh: 田甲曰：「然即溺之。」
units.en: Tian Jia said, "If they blaze, I will urinate on them."
units.literal: Tian Jia said: "If they blaze, I will urinate on them."

units.zh: 居無何，梁內史缺，漢使使者拜安國為梁內史，起徒中為二千石。
units.en: Before long, the position of Prefect of Liang fell vacant. The Han court sent an envoy to appoint Anguo as Prefect of Liang, raising him from prisoner to an official of two-thousand-shi rank.
units.literal: Resided no long, Liang internal affairs vacant, Han sent envoy appointed Anguo as Liang internal affairs, rose from prisoner became two thousand shi.

units.zh: 田甲亡走。
units.en: Tian Jia fled in terror.
units.literal: Tian Jia fled ran.

units.zh: 安國曰：「甲不就官，我滅而宗。」
units.en: Anguo said, "If Jia does not take up his post, I will exterminate his clan."
units.literal: Anguo said: "If Jia does not take up his post, I will exterminate his clan."

units.zh: 甲因肉袒謝。
units.en: Tian Jia accordingly bared his torso and prostrated himself in apology.
units.literal: Jia therefore bared flesh apologized.

units.zh: 安國笑曰：「可溺矣！
units.en: Anguo laughed and said, "You may urinate on them now!
units.literal: Anguo laughed and said: "You may urinate now!

units.zh: 公等足與治乎？」
units.en: Are you gentlemen fit to govern?"
units.literal: Are you gentlemen fit to govern?"

units.zh: 卒善遇之。
units.en: In the end, Anguo treated him with kindness.
units.literal: Finally well treated him.

units.zh: 梁內史之缺也，孝王新得齊人公孫詭，說之，欲請以為內史。
units.en: When the position of Prefect fell vacant, King Xiao had recently taken a liking to Gongsun Gui, a man from Qi who had won the king's favor through persuasive counsel, and wished to request his appointment as Prefect.
units.literal: Liang internal affairs vacancy, Xiao wang newly got Qi person Gongsun Gui, persuaded him, wanted request appoint as internal affairs.

units.zh: 竇太后聞，乃詔王以安國為內史。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Dou heard of this, she issued a decree commanding the king to appoint Anguo as Prefect instead.
units.literal: Dou empress dowager heard, then decreed wang with Anguo as internal affairs.

units.zh: 公孫詭、羊勝說孝王求為帝太子及益地事，恐漢大臣不聽，乃陰使人刺漢用事謀臣。
units.en: Gongsun Gui and Yang Sheng persuaded King Xiao to seek designation as the Emperor's heir apparent and to petition for additional territory. Fearing that the great ministers of Han would not comply, they secretly sent assassins to murder the influential advisors at the Han court.
units.literal: Gongsun Gui, Yang Sheng persuaded Xiao wang seek be emperor crown prince and increase territory matters, feared Han great ministers not listen, then secretly sent people assassinated Han in power plotting ministers.

units.zh: 及殺故吳相袁盎，景帝遂聞詭、勝等計畫，乃遣使捕詭、勝，必得。
units.en: When they murdered Yuan Ang, the former Chancellor of Wu, Emperor Jing at last learned of the plots of Gongsun Gui and Yang Sheng. He dispatched envoys to arrest them, with orders that they must be captured.
units.literal: And killed former Wu chancellor Yuan Ang, Emperor Jing then heard Gui, Sheng etc. plans, then sent envoys arrest Gui, Sheng, must obtain.

units.zh: 漢使十輩至梁，相以下舉國大索，月餘不得。
units.en: Ten groups of Han envoys arrived in Liang, and the Chancellor and all officials below him mobilized the entire kingdom in a great search, but after more than a month they could not find them.
units.literal: Han sent ten groups to Liang, chancellor below mobilized whole country great search, month remainder not obtained.

units.zh: 內史安國聞詭、勝匿孝王所，安國入見王而泣曰：「主辱臣死。
units.en: Prefect Anguo learned that Gongsun Gui and Yang Sheng were hidden at King Xiao's residence. Anguo entered to see the king and wept, saying, "When the lord is disgraced, his minister must die.
units.literal: Prefect Anguo heard Gui and Sheng were hidden at King Xiao's place; Anguo entered to see the king and wept, saying: "When the lord is disgraced, his minister must die.

units.zh: 大王無良臣，故事紛紛至此。
units.en: Your Majesty has no worthy ministers, and so affairs have descended into this chaos.
units.literal: Great wang without good ministers, therefore matters confused to this.

units.zh: 今詭、勝不得，請辭賜死。」
units.en: Since Gui and Sheng cannot be captured, I ask to withdraw and receive death."
units.literal: Since Gui and Sheng cannot be captured, I beg to resign and accept death."

units.zh: 王曰：「何至此？」
units.en: The king said, "How has it come to this?"
units.literal: The king said: "How has it come to this?"

units.zh: 安國泣數行下，曰：「大王自度於皇帝，孰與太上皇之與高皇帝及皇帝之與臨江王親？」
units.en: Anguo wept, his tears streaming down several lines, and said, "Your Majesty, compare for yourself your closeness to the Emperor—which is greater, the relation between the Grand Emperor Father and Emperor Gaozu, or that between the Emperor and the King of Linjiang?"
units.literal: Anguo wept, tears streaming down several lines, and said: "Your Majesty, compare for yourself your closeness to the Emperor—which is greater, the relation between the Grand Emperor Father and Emperor Gaozu, or that between the Emperor and the King of Linjiang?"

units.zh: 孝王曰：「弗如也。」
units.en: King Xiao said, "It does not compare."
units.literal: King Xiao said: "It does not compare."

units.zh: 安國曰：「夫太上、臨江親父子之閒，然而高帝曰『提三尺劍取天下者朕也』，故太上皇終不得制事，居于櫟陽。
units.en: Anguo said, "The Grand Emperor Father and the King of Linjiang both stood within the closest bonds of father and son. Yet Emperor Gaozu said, 'It was I who took the empire with a three-foot sword,' and so the Grand Emperor Father in the end could not direct affairs, but lived at Liyang.
units.literal: Anguo said: "Between the Grand Emperor Father and the King of Linjiang there was the closest bond of father and son, yet Emperor Gaozu said, 'It is I who took the empire with a three-foot sword,' so the Grand Emperor Father in the end could not control affairs and lived at Liyang.

units.zh: 臨江王，適長太子也，以一言過，廢王臨江；
units.en: The King of Linjiang was the legitimate eldest crown prince, yet because of a single verbal fault he was deposed and made King of Linjiang;
units.literal: The King of Linjiang was the legitimate eldest heir apparent; for one slip of the tongue he was deposed and made King of Linjiang;

units.zh: 用宮垣事，卒自殺中尉府。
units.en: On account of the incident at the palace walls, he ended by taking his own life in the Commandant's office.
units.literal: Used palace wall matter, finally suicide in commandants office.

units.zh: 何者？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 治天下終不以私亂公。
units.en: In governing the realm, he never allowed private interests to disrupt public affairs.
units.literal: Governing realm finally not with private confuse public.

units.zh: 語曰：『雖有親父，安知其不為虎？
units.en: The saying goes, 'Even with a close father, who can be sure he will not become a tiger?
units.literal: The saying goes: 'Even with a close father, who can be sure he will not become a tiger?

units.zh: 雖有親兄，安知其不為狼？』
units.en: Even with a close elder brother, who can know that he will not become a wolf?'
units.literal: Even with a close elder brother, who can be sure he will not become a wolf?'

units.zh: 今大王列在諸侯，悅一邪臣浮說，犯上禁，橈明法。
units.en: Now Your Majesty ranks among the feudal lords, yet you have delighted in the reckless counsel of a treacherous minister, violated the Emperor's prohibitions, and subverted the clear laws.
units.literal: Now great wang ranked among feudal lords, pleased one wicked minister empty talk, violated emperor prohibition, bent clear law.

units.zh: 天子以太后故，不忍致法於王。
units.en: The Emperor, out of regard for the Empress Dowager, cannot bring himself to enforce the law against the king.
units.literal: Emperor because empress dowager reason, not bear apply law to wang.

units.zh: 太后日夜涕泣，幸大王自改，而大王終不覺寤。
units.en: The Empress Dowager weeps day and night, hoping that Your Majesty will reform on your own, yet Your Majesty never comes to his senses.
units.literal: Empress dowager day night wept, hoped great wang self change, but great wang finally not aware enlightened.

units.zh: 有如太后宮車即晏駕，大王尚誰攀乎？」
units.en: If the Empress Dowager's palace carriage should depart on its final journey, whom would Your Majesty still have to cling to?"
units.literal: If the Empress Dowager's carriage should set out on its final journey, whom will Your Majesty still have to rely upon?"

units.zh: 語未卒，孝王泣數行下，謝安國曰：「吾今出詭、勝。」
units.en: Before Anguo had finished speaking, King Xiao wept, tears streaming down several lines, and apologized to Anguo, saying, "I will now hand over Gui and Sheng."
units.literal: Before Anguo had finished speaking, King Xiao wept, tears streaming down several lines, and apologized to Anguo, saying: "I will now hand over Gui and Sheng."

units.zh: 詭、勝自殺。
units.en: Gongsun Gui and Yang Sheng took their own lives.
units.literal: Gui, Sheng suicide.

units.zh: 漢使還報，梁事皆得釋，安國之力也。
units.en: When the Han envoys returned with their report, all charges against Liang were dropped—this was entirely through Anguo's efforts.
units.literal: Han envoys returned report, Liang matters all got released, Anguo effort.

units.zh: 於是景帝、太后益重安國。
units.en: From then on, Emperor Jing and the Empress Dowager valued Anguo even more highly.
units.literal: Thereupon Emperor Jing, empress dowager increasingly valued Anguo.

units.zh: 孝王卒，共王即位，安國坐法失官，居家。
units.en: When King Xiao died and King Gong succeeded him, Anguo was convicted of an offense and stripped of his position, retiring to his home.
units.literal: Xiao wang died, Gong wang ascended throne, Anguo sat law lost office, resided home.

units.zh: 建元中，武安侯田蚡為漢太尉，親貴用事，安國以五百金物遺蚡。
units.en: During the Jianyuan reign period, the Marquis of Wuan, Tian Fen, served as Grand Commandant of Han. He wielded power as an intimate of the imperial family, and Anguo presented him with gifts worth five hundred pieces of gold.
units.literal: Jianyuan middle, Wuan marquis Tian Fen became Han commander, intimate noble in power, Anguo with five hundred gold objects gifted Fen.

units.zh: 蚡言安國太后，天子亦素聞其賢，即召以為北地都尉，遷為大司農。
units.en: Tian Fen commended Anguo to the Empress Dowager. The Emperor, who had long heard of his abilities, immediately summoned him and appointed him Commandant of Beidi, then promoted him to Grand Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: Fen spoke Anguo to empress dowager, emperor also long heard his worthy, immediately summoned appointed as Beidi commandery governor, promoted to grand minister agriculture.

units.zh: 閩越、東越相攻，安國及大行王恢將。
units.en: When Minyue and Dongyue attacked each other, Anguo and the Grand Herald Wang Hui were appointed to lead the campaign.
units.literal: Min Yue, Dong Yue mutually attacked, Anguo and grand traveler Wang Hui led.

units.zh: 未至越，越殺其王降，漢兵亦罷。
units.en: Before the army reached Yue, the people of Yue killed their king and surrendered, and the Han forces were recalled.
units.literal: Not arrived Yue, Yue killed their wang surrendered, Han troops also dismissed.

units.zh: 建元六年，武安侯為丞相，安國為御史大夫。
units.en: In the sixth year of the Jianyuan reign, the Marquis of Wuan became Chancellor, and Anguo became Grand Censor.
units.literal: The sixth year of Jianyuan, Wuan marquis became chancellor, Anguo became imperial censor.

units.zh: 匈奴來請和親，天子下議。
units.en: The Xiongnu sent envoys requesting a marriage alliance, and the Emperor referred the matter to his ministers for deliberation.
units.literal: Xiongnu came request peaceful marriage alliance, emperor below discussed.

units.zh: 大行王恢，燕人也，數為邊吏，習知胡事。
units.en: The Grand Herald Wang Hui was a native of Yan who had served repeatedly as a border official and was well versed in the affairs of the northern tribes.
units.literal: Grand traveler Wang Hui, Yan person, repeatedly served border officials, familiar knew barbarian matters.

units.zh: 議曰：「漢與匈奴和親，率不過數歲即復倍約。
units.en: The deliberation stated, "Whenever Han and the Xiongnu make a marriage alliance, within only a few years they break the treaty again.
units.literal: The deliberation stated: "Whenever Han and the Xiongnu make a marriage alliance, within only a few years they break the treaty again.

units.zh: 不如勿許，興兵擊之。」
units.en: It would be better to refuse it and raise troops to attack them."
units.literal: It would be better not to grant it and to raise troops to attack them."

units.zh: 安國曰：「千里而戰，兵不獲利。
units.en: Anguo said, "To fight a battle a thousand li away brings the army no profit.
units.literal: Anguo said: "To fight a battle a thousand li away brings the army no profit.

units.zh: 今匈奴負戎馬之足，懷禽獸之心，遷徙鳥舉，難得而制也。
units.en: The Xiongnu rely on the swiftness of their warhorses, harbor the hearts of beasts, and migrate as freely as flocking birds—they are impossible to seize and control.
units.literal: Now Xiongnu rely on warhorse feet, harbor bird beast heart, migrate fly like birds, hard obtain and control.

units.zh: 得其地不足以為廣，有其眾不足以為彊，自上古不屬為人。
units.en: To conquer their land would not be enough to expand our territory; to absorb their people would not be enough to strengthen our state. Since the most ancient times, they have never been counted among the civilized.
units.literal: Get their land insufficient to make broad, have their multitude insufficient to make strong, from ancient not belonged to people.

units.zh: 漢數千里爭利，則人馬罷，虜以全制其敝。
units.en: If Han marches thousands of li to contend with them, our men and horses will be exhausted, and the enemy will use their fresh forces to exploit our weariness.
units.literal: Han several thousand li contend profit, then men horses tired, enemy with whole control their exhaustion.

units.zh: 且彊弩之極，矢不能穿魯縞；
units.en: Moreover, once a powerful crossbow has spent its force, its arrow cannot pierce Lu silk;
units.literal: Moreover, when a strong crossbow has reached its limit, the arrow cannot pierce a strip of Lu silk;

units.zh: 沖風之末，力不能漂鴻毛。
units.en: At the end of a rushing gale, the remaining force cannot even lift a goose feather.
units.literal: Charge wind end, force cannot drift swan feather.

units.zh: 非初不勁，末力衰也。
units.en: It is not that the initial force was weak—rather, their strength runs out by the end.
units.literal: Not initial not strong, end force decline.

units.zh: 擊之不便，不如和親。」
units.en: Attacking them would bring no advantage; a marriage alliance is preferable."
units.literal: To attack them is impractical; peace by marriage alliance is better."

units.zh: 群臣議者多附安國，於是上許和親。
units.en: The majority of the ministers who deliberated sided with Anguo, and so the Emperor approved the marriage alliance.
units.literal: Ministers discussing mostly attached Anguo, thereupon emperor permitted peaceful marriage alliance.

units.zh: 其明年，則元光元年，雁門馬邑豪聶翁壹因大行王恢言上曰：「匈奴初和親，親信邊，可誘以利。」
units.en: The next year, the first year of Yuanguang, Nie Wengyi, a wealthy man of Mayi in Yanmen, spoke to the Emperor through the Grand Herald Wang Hui, saying, "The Xiongnu have just made a marriage alliance and trust the border officials; they can be lured with profit."
units.literal: The next year, the first year of Yuanguang, Nie Wengyi, a wealthy man of Mayi in Yanmen, spoke to the Emperor through the Grand Herald Wang Hui, saying: "The Xiongnu have just made a marriage alliance and trust the border officials; they can be lured with profit."

units.zh: 陰使聶翁壹為閒，亡入匈奴，謂單于曰：「吾能斬馬邑令丞吏，以城降，財物可盡得。」
units.en: They secretly sent Nie Wengyi as an agent. He fled into the Xiongnu and told the Chanyu, "I can behead the magistrate, assistant, and clerks of Mayi and surrender the city, so that all its goods may be taken."
units.literal: They secretly sent Nie Wengyi as a spy; he fled into the Xiongnu and said to the Chanyu, "I can behead the magistrate, assistant, and clerks of Mayi and surrender the city; all its goods may be yours."

units.zh: 單于愛信之，以為然，許聶翁壹。
units.en: The Chanyu, who trusted and favored him, found the proposal reasonable and granted Nie Wengyi permission to proceed.
units.literal: Chanyu loved trusted him, considered correct, permitted Nie Wengyi.

units.zh: 聶翁壹乃還，詐斬死罪囚，縣其頭馬邑城，示單于使者為信。
units.en: Nie Wengyi then returned, beheaded a prisoner condemned to death, and hung the head on the walls of Maiyi, displaying it to the Chanyu's envoy as proof.
units.literal: Nie Wengyi then returned, falsely beheaded death penalty prisoner, hung his head Maiyi city, showed chanyu envoy as proof.

units.zh: 曰：「馬邑長吏已死，可急來。」
units.en: He said, "The chief officers of Mayi are already dead; come quickly."
units.literal: He said: "The chief officers of Mayi are already dead; come quickly."

units.zh: 於是單于穿塞將十餘萬騎，入武州塞。
units.en: The Chanyu then breached the frontier and led more than a hundred thousand cavalry through the Wuzhou pass.
units.literal: Thereupon chanyu pierced pass led ten remainder ten thousand cavalry, entered Wuzhou pass.

units.zh: 當是時，漢伏兵車騎材官二十餘萬，匿馬邑旁谷中。
units.en: At that time, the Han had concealed more than two hundred thousand troops—chariots, cavalry, and infantry—in the valleys beside Maiyi.
units.literal: At this time, Han ambushed troops chariots cavalry material officials twenty remainder ten thousand, hid Maiyi side valley middle.

units.zh: 衛尉李廣為驍騎將軍，太仆公孫賀為輕車將軍，大行王恢為將屯將軍，太中大夫李息為材官將軍。
units.en: The Captain of the Guard Li Guang was appointed General of Agile Cavalry, the Grand Coachman Gongsun He was appointed General of Light Chariots, the Grand Herald Wang Hui was appointed General of the Garrison, and the Palace Grandee Li Xi was appointed General of Infantry.
units.literal: Guard Wei Li Guang became fierce cavalry general, master carriages Gongsun He became light chariot general, grand traveler Wang Hui became army garrison general, palace grand master Li Xi became material official general.

units.zh: 御史大夫韓安國為護軍將軍，諸將皆屬護軍。
units.en: The Grand Censor Han Anguo was appointed General Protector of the Army, and all the other generals were placed under his command.
units.literal: Imperial censor Han Anguo became protect army general, various generals all belonged protect army.

units.zh: 約單于入馬邑而漢兵縱發。
units.en: The plan was that once the Chanyu entered Maiyi, the Han forces would spring their attack.
units.literal: Agreed chanyu enter Maiyi and Han troops then launch.

units.zh: 王恢、李息、李廣別從代主擊其輜重。
units.en: Wang Hui, Li Xi, and Li Guang were to advance separately from Dai to strike the Xiongnu supply train.
units.literal: Wang Hui, Li Xi, Li Guang separately from Dai command strike their baggage heavy.

units.zh: 於是單于入漢長城武州塞。
units.en: The Chanyu then entered the Han Great Wall through the Wuzhou pass.
units.literal: Thereupon chanyu entered Han Great Wall Wuzhou pass.

units.zh: 未至馬邑百餘里，行掠鹵，徒見畜牧於野，不見一人。
units.en: When he was still more than a hundred li from Maiyi, he went raiding and plundering, but saw only livestock grazing in the fields and not a single person.
units.literal: Not arrived Maiyi hundred remainder li, went plundering, only saw livestock pasturing in field, not saw one person.

units.zh: 單于怪之，攻烽燧，得武州尉史。
units.en: The Chanyu grew suspicious, attacked a beacon tower, and captured the garrison officer of Wuzhou.
units.literal: Chanyu wondered it, attacked beacon signal, obtained Wuzhou wei shi.

units.zh: 欲刺問尉史。
units.en: He threatened the officer with torture to extract information.
units.literal: Wanted stab question wei shi.

units.zh: 尉史曰：「漢兵數十萬伏馬邑下。」
units.en: The garrison officer said, "Several hundred thousand Han troops are lying in ambush below Mayi."
units.literal: The garrison officer said: "Several hundred thousand Han troops are lying in ambush below Mayi."

units.zh: 單于顧謂左右曰：「幾為漢所賣！」
units.en: The Chanyu turned to his attendants and said, "We were nearly sold out by the Han!"
units.literal: The Chanyu turned to his attendants and said: "We were nearly sold out by the Han!"

units.zh: 乃引兵還。
units.en: He then withdrew his forces and turned back.
units.literal: Then led troops return.

units.zh: 出塞，曰：「吾得尉史，乃天也。」
units.en: As he left the pass, he said, "To have obtained this garrison officer was Heaven's doing."
units.literal: As he left the pass, he said: "To have obtained this garrison officer was Heaven's doing."

units.zh: 命尉史為「天王」。
units.en: He named the garrison officer "Heavenly King."
units.literal: He named the garrison officer "Heavenly King."

units.zh: 塞下傳言單于已引去。
units.en: Word reached the frontier that the Chanyu had already retreated.
units.literal: Pass below transmitted words chanyu already led away.

units.zh: 漢兵追至塞，度弗及，即罷。
units.en: The Han forces gave chase as far as the frontier, but judging they could not catch him, they withdrew.
units.literal: Han troops pursued to pass, measured not reach, then dismissed.

units.zh: 王恢等兵三萬，聞單于不與漢合，度往擊輜重，必與單于精兵戰，漢兵勢必敗，則以便宜罷兵，皆無功。
units.en: Wang Hui and his thirty thousand troops, learning that the Chanyu had not engaged with the Han forces, calculated that if they went to attack the supply train they would inevitably have to fight the Chanyu's elite cavalry and would surely be defeated. He therefore used his discretion to withdraw his forces, and all ended without achievement.
units.literal: Wang Hui etc. troops three ten thousand, heard chanyu not with Han engage, measured go attack baggage heavy, must with chanyu elite troops battle, Han troops situation must defeat, then with discretion dismissed troops, all no merit.

units.zh: 天子怒王恢不出擊單于輜重，擅引兵罷也。
units.en: The Emperor was furious that Wang Hui had failed to attack the Chanyu's supply train and had withdrawn his forces without authorization.
units.literal: Emperor angered Wang Hui not out attack chanyu baggage heavy, arbitrarily led troops dismissed.

units.zh: 恢曰：「始約虜入馬邑城，兵與單于接，而臣擊其輜重，可得利。
units.en: Wang Hui said, "The original plan was for the enemy to enter Mayi city, for our troops to engage the Chanyu, and for me to strike his baggage train and gain advantage.
units.literal: Wang Hui said: "The original plan was for the enemy to enter Mayi city, for our troops to engage the Chanyu, and for me to strike his baggage train and gain advantage.

units.zh: 今單于聞，不至而還，臣以三萬人眾不敵，禔取辱耳。
units.en: Now that the Chanyu was forewarned and turned back before arriving, with my thirty thousand men I was no match for him and would only have met with humiliation.
units.literal: Now chanyu heard, not arrived and return, subject with three ten thousand people multitude not match, only take humiliation.

units.zh: 臣固知還而斬，然得完陛下士三萬人。」
units.en: I knew perfectly well that returning would mean beheading, yet I was able to preserve Your Majesty's thirty thousand soldiers."
units.literal: I knew well that if I returned I would be beheaded, yet I was able to preserve Your Majesty's thirty thousand soldiers."

units.zh: 於是下恢廷尉。
units.en: Wang Hui was thereupon handed over to the Commandant of Justice.
units.literal: Thereupon sent Hui to judicial court.

units.zh: 廷尉當恢逗橈，當斬。
units.en: The Commandant of Justice charged Hui with delaying and obstructing the campaign, and sentenced him to death.
units.literal: Judicial court judged Hui delayed obstructed, should behead.

units.zh: 恢私行千金丞相蚡。
units.en: Hui secretly sent a thousand pieces of gold to the Chancellor Tian Fen.
units.literal: Hui privately sent thousand gold chancellor Fen.

units.zh: 蚡不敢言上，而言於太后曰：「王恢首造馬邑事，今不成而誅恢，是為匈奴報仇也。」
units.en: Tian Fen did not dare speak to the Emperor but said to the Empress Dowager, "Wang Hui was the first to devise the Mayi plan; to execute him now that it has failed would be taking revenge for the Xiongnu."
units.literal: Tian Fen did not dare speak to the Emperor but said to the Empress Dowager: "Wang Hui was the first to devise the Mayi plan; to execute him now that it has failed would be taking revenge for the Xiongnu."

units.zh: 上朝太后，太后以丞相言告上。
units.en: When the Emperor paid his respects to the Empress Dowager, she conveyed the Chancellor's words to him.
units.literal: Emperor court empress dowager, empress dowager with chancellor words told emperor.

units.zh: 上曰：「首為馬邑事者，恢也，故發天下兵數十萬，從其言，為此。
units.en: The Emperor said, "Wang Hui was the first to propose the Mayi affair, and so I raised several hundred thousand troops from across the realm and followed his plan for this reason.
units.literal: The Emperor said: "Wang Hui was the first to propose the Mayi affair, and so I raised several hundred thousand troops from across the realm and followed his plan for this reason.

units.zh: 且縱單于不可得，恢所部擊其輜重，猶頗可得，以慰士大夫心。
units.en: Even if the Chanyu himself could not have been captured, had Hui led his forces to attack the supply train, there would still have been considerable gains to comfort the hearts of the soldiers and officials.
units.literal: Moreover, even chanyu cannot obtain, Hui his command attack their baggage heavy, still considerably can obtain, to comfort scholar officials heart.

units.zh: 今不誅恢，無以謝天下。」
units.en: If Wang Hui is not executed now, there will be no way to answer to the realm."
units.literal: If we do not execute Wang Hui now, we have no way to answer to the realm."

units.zh: 於是恢聞之，乃自殺。
units.en: When Hui learned of this, he took his own life.
units.literal: Thereupon Hui heard it, then suicide.

units.zh: 安國為人多大略，智足以當世取合，而出於忠厚焉。
units.en: Anguo was a man of broad vision and grand strategy, wise enough to navigate the politics of his age and win favor, and all of this was rooted in his loyalty and generosity of spirit.
units.literal: Anguo as person much grand strategy, wisdom sufficient to match age obtain harmony, moreover came from loyal generous.

units.zh: 貪嗜於財。
units.en: He was, however, greedy for wealth.
units.literal: Greedy fond of wealth.

units.zh: 所推舉皆廉士，賢於己者也。
units.en: Those he recommended were all men of integrity, worthier than himself.
units.literal: What recommended all incorruptible scholars, worthy than himself.

units.zh: 於梁舉壺遂、臧固、郅他，皆天下名士，士亦以此稱慕之，唯天子以為國器。
units.en: While in Liang, he recommended Hu Sui, Zang Gu, and Zhi Ta, all renowned scholars of the realm. The scholarly community praised and admired him for this, and even the Emperor regarded him as a pillar of the state.
units.literal: In Liang recommended Hu Sui, Zang Gu, Zhi Ta, all realm famous scholars, scholars also with this praised admired him, only emperor considered as state vessel.

units.zh: 安國為御史大夫四歲餘，丞相田蚡死，安國行丞相事，奉引墮車蹇。
units.en: Anguo served as Grand Censor for more than four years. When the Chancellor Tian Fen died, Anguo assumed the duties of Chancellor. But while leading the imperial procession, he fell from his carriage and injured his leg.
units.literal: Anguo became imperial censor four years remainder, chancellor Tian Fen died, Anguo acted chancellor matters, honored pulled carriage lame.

units.zh: 天子議置相，欲用安國，使使視之，蹇甚，乃更以平棘侯薛澤為丞相。
units.en: The Emperor wished to make Anguo Chancellor and sent an envoy to assess his condition, but his lameness was severe. He therefore appointed the Marquis of Pingji, Xue Ze, as Chancellor instead.
units.literal: Emperor discussed appoint chancellor, wanted use Anguo, sent envoy see him, lame severe, then changed with Pingji marquis Xue Ze as chancellor.

units.zh: 安國病免數月，蹇愈，上復以安國為中尉。
units.en: Anguo was relieved of his duties for several months due to illness. When his lameness healed, the Emperor reappointed him as Commandant of the Capital.
units.literal: Anguo ill dismissed several months, lame cured, emperor again with Anguo as commandants.

units.zh: 歲餘，徙為衛尉。
units.en: After about a year, he was transferred to the post of Captain of the Guard.
units.literal: Year remainder, moved became guard wei.

units.zh: 車騎將軍衛青擊匈奴，出上谷，破胡蘢城。
units.en: The General of Chariots and Cavalry, Wei Qing, attacked the Xiongnu, marching out from Shanggu, and captured the Xiongnu fortress of Longcheng.
units.literal: Chariot cavalry general Wei Qing attacked Xiongnu, out Shanggu, broke Hu Wei city.

units.zh: 將軍李廣為匈奴所得，復失之；
units.en: General Li Guang was captured by the Xiongnu but escaped again;
units.literal: General Li Guang by Xiongnu was obtained, again lost him;

units.zh: 公孫敖大亡卒：皆當斬，贖為庶人。
units.en: Gongsun Ao lost many of his troops: both were liable to execution but redeemed their sentences and were reduced to commoners.
units.literal: Gongsun Ao greatly lost troops: all should be beheaded, redeemed as commoners.

units.zh: 明年，匈奴大入邊，殺遼西太守，及入鴈門，所殺略數千人。
units.en: The following year, the Xiongnu launched a major invasion of the border, killed the Governor of Liaoxi, and penetrated Yanmen, killing and capturing several thousand people.
units.literal: Next year, Xiongnu greatly entered border, killed Liaoxi governor, and entered Yanmen, what killed plundered several thousand people.

units.zh: 車騎將軍衛青擊之，出鴈門。
units.en: The General of Chariots and Cavalry, Wei Qing, was sent to attack them, marching out from Yanmen.
units.literal: Chariot cavalry general Wei Qing attacked them, out Yanmen.

units.zh: 衛尉安國為材官將軍，屯於漁陽。
units.en: The Captain of the Guard, Anguo, was appointed General of Infantry and garrisoned at Yuyang.
units.literal: Guard wei Anguo became material official general, garrisoned at Yuyang.

units.zh: 安國捕生虜，言匈奴遠去。
units.en: Anguo captured prisoners alive, who reported that the Xiongnu had withdrawn far away.
units.literal: Anguo captured living captives, spoke Xiongnu far gone.

units.zh: 即上書言方田作時，請且罷軍屯。
units.en: He thereupon submitted a memorial stating that it was the farming season and requested that the garrison be temporarily disbanded.
units.literal: Immediately memorial spoke farming work time, requested temporarily dismiss army garrison.

units.zh: 罷軍屯月餘，匈奴大入上谷、漁陽。
units.en: Barely a month after the garrison was disbanded, the Xiongnu launched a massive invasion of Shanggu and Yuyang.
units.literal: Dismissed army garrison month remainder, Xiongnu greatly entered Shanggu, Yuyang.

units.zh: 安國壁乃有七百餘人，出與戰，不勝，復入壁。
units.en: Anguo's fortress held only some seven hundred men. They sallied forth to fight but could not prevail, and retreated back behind the walls.
units.literal: Anguo defensive wall then had seven hundred remainder people, out with battle, not win, again entered wall.

units.zh: 匈奴虜略千餘人及畜產而去。
units.en: The Xiongnu captured and carried off more than a thousand people along with their livestock and departed.
units.literal: Xiongnu captives plundered thousand remainder people and livestock produce and left.

units.zh: 天子聞之，怒，使使責讓安國。
units.en: When the Emperor heard of this, he was furious and sent an envoy to reprimand Anguo.
units.literal: Emperor heard it, angered, sent envoy blamed rebuked Anguo.

units.zh: 徒安國益東，屯右北平。
units.en: He transferred Anguo further east to garrison Youbeiping.
units.literal: Moved Anguo eastward more, garrisoned Youbeiping.

units.zh: 是時匈奴虜言當入東方。
units.en: At that time, Xiongnu prisoners reported that an invasion of the eastern regions was imminent.
units.literal: At time Xiongnu captives spoke should enter eastern direction.

units.zh: 安國始為御史大夫及護軍，後稍斥疏，下遷；
units.en: Anguo had first served as Grand Censor and General Protector of the Army, but was later gradually distanced and demoted;
units.literal: Anguo first was Grand Censor and Protector of Army, later gradually expelled distant, demoted downward;

units.zh: 而新幸壯將軍衛青等有功，益貴。
units.en: Meanwhile, the newly favored young generals such as Wei Qing had won victories and were rising ever higher in status.
units.literal: But newly favored vigorous generals Wei Qing etc. had merit, increasingly noble.

units.zh: 安國既疏遠，默默也；
units.en: Anguo, now distant from favor, kept silent;
units.literal: Anguo already distant, silent;

units.zh: 將屯又為匈奴所欺，失亡多，甚自愧。
units.en: His garrison command had been outwitted by the Xiongnu, suffering heavy losses, and he was deeply ashamed.
units.literal: Army garrison moreover by Xiongnu deceived, lost perished many, very self ashamed.

units.zh: 幸得罷歸，乃益東徙屯，意忽忽不樂。
units.en: When he was finally relieved from the frontier, only to be transferred to a garrison even further east, he fell into a deep melancholy.
units.literal: Fortunately obtained dismissed return, then increasingly eastward moved garrison, intention despondent not happy.

units.zh: 數月，病歐血死。
units.en: After several months, he fell ill, vomited blood, and died.
units.literal: Several months, ill vomited blood died.

units.zh: 安國以元朔二年中卒。
units.en: Anguo died in the middle of the second year of the Yuanshuo reign.
units.literal: Anguo with the second year of Yuanshuo middle died.

units.zh: 太史公曰：余與壺遂定律歷，觀韓長孺之義，壺遂之深中隱厚。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: I worked with Hu Sui on establishing the calendar and laws, and observed Han Changru's integrity and Hu Sui's profound inner reserve and hidden depth of character.
units.literal: Grand Historian says: I worked with Hu Sui on establishing the calendar and laws, and observed Han Changru's integrity and Hu Sui's profound inner reserve and hidden depth of character.

units.zh: 世之言梁多長者，不虛哉！
units.en: The saying in the world that Liang produces many worthy elders is no empty phrase!
units.literal: The world's saying that Liang produces many men of worth is no empty saying!

units.zh: 壺遂官至詹事，天子方倚以為漢相，會遂卒。
units.en: Hu Sui rose to the office of Director of Palace Affairs, and the Emperor was on the verge of appointing him Chancellor of Han when Hu Sui died.
units.literal: Hu Sui office reached director of palace affairs, emperor just relied to be Han chancellor, met Sui died.

units.zh: 不然，壺遂之內廉行修，斯鞠躬君子也。
units.en: Had it not been so, given Hu Sui's inner integrity and cultivated conduct, he would truly have been a gentleman devoted body and soul to the state.
units.literal: Not so, Hu Sui internal incorrupt conduct cultivated, this bowed gentleman.
